agent_notes: Government listing was established in all three supplied NIRF 2025 sources.
The official contact page verifies Kalyanpur, Kanpur, but retrieved official pages do not explicitly name the administrative district; district was left null rather than inferred as Kanpur Nagar.

Normal TLS verification returned the managed proxy error 'self signed certificate in certificate chain'; curl --insecure was then used only for public GETs to the expected NIRF, iitk.ac.in and online.iitk.ac.in hosts.

The catalogue is split across current DoAA pages, updated UG/PG manuals, the 2026-27 PG admissions page, the B.Cyber page and the IIT Kanpur Online Programs hub. Older DoAA pages omit newer offerings; current sources were used for Intelligent Systems, B.Cyber, current PG departments and online programmes.
The eMasters landing page states 'No Future Admissions to eMasters Program'; it was excluded as inactive. News, internships, workshops and expired short-term events were excluded.

Career mappings were reviewed against assets/data/career_path.db read-only. Nearest-parent or closest-specialization mappings are explicitly labelled; the generic on-campus PG Diploma remains unmapped with mapping_gap.
